title: PM SHRI Schools (Prime Minister Schools for Rising India):
summary: Schemes — PM SHRI Schools (Prime Minister Schools for Rising India):

items: o Objective: Upgrade 14,500 schools under the NEP
o Modernization of infrastructure, smart classrooms, labs, and sports facilities
o Focus on discovery-based, student-centric learning
o Schools to mentor nearby institutions
o Teacher training for innovative education
o 402 schools selected in Rajasthan (28 in Jaipur, 24 in Jodhpur)
This initiative aims to raise educational standards and leadership across India.
